scope: Descriptive analysis of one fixed training seed 17; 10 paired development evaluation episodes 30000-30009 per case. No final-test or multi-training-seed claim. No model re-selection.

metric_definitions.J: (1/(60*N))*sum_t sum_i T_i/d_i; dimensionless normalized weighted delay, not raw weighted sum
metric_definitions.delay_s: Arithmetic average task delay in seconds
metric_definitions.energy_j: Three UAV propulsion plus compute energy per 60-slot episode
metric_definitions.energy_feasible: All three individual UAV energies <= 12000 J; a fleet total below 36000 J is insufficient
metric_definitions.return: -300*J-penalty_sum for every case because delay weight=5 and horizon=60

metadata_reconciliation.raw_frame_hash_and_all_108_training_coun: Collector reports passed; this analysis independently reads reports only, raw-data verification is a separate archive audit.
